answer: Each AI agent registers a vertex stamped with a unique opal‑derived credential signed by a quorum of existing nodes; newcomers must obtain vouch tokens by walking a random‑seeded path of length k through the vouching graph, collecting nectar from each intermediate vertex as proof of honest proximity.
